title: Self-supervised learning
reading: A short text-only slide that frames the two families of modern self-supervised learning methods: contrastive learning and predictive learning. It acts as a roadmap heading into detailed treatment of each, with no elaboration given here.

concepts.name: Self-supervised learning
concepts.why_it_matters: Learning representations from unlabeled data via pretext objectives.

concepts.name: Contrastive learning
concepts.why_it_matters: One of the two main modern SSL families, based on pulling together positive pairs and pushing apart negatives.

concepts.name: Predictive learning
concepts.why_it_matters: The alternative SSL family, where the model predicts missing or future parts of the input.
